meals.name: One-Pan Coconut Curry Salmon
ings: Fresh cilantro or basil for garnish
steps: Cook rice with 1 can of coconut milk
Pat salmon dry; season with salt, pepper, paprika. Heat oil in skillet over medium-high. Sear salmon skin-side down 3–4 min until crispy. Flip, cook 2 more min. Remove to a plate.
Lower heat; melt butter in same pan. Sauté garlic and ginger 1 min. Stir in curry powder and turmeric; toast 30 sec until fragrant.
Add coconut milk, tomato paste, honey, soy sauce, and juice from 1 lime. Whisk together and simmer 5 min until slightly thickened.
Return salmon to pan; spoon sauce over. Simmer 5 min until salmon is cooked through and sauce coats it.
Cook cherry tomatoes in a pan until soft and starting to get jammy.
Garnish with cilantro. Serve over jasmine rice with extra sauce spooned over the top.
meals.note: 💡 Skipping the red pepper flakes keeps this totally kid-friendly. The curry powder + turmeric give warmth and color without heat. Serve over rice to soak up the sauce.
meals.label: Meal A

meals.name: White Chicken Chili
ings: 1½ tsp ground cumin, ¼ tsp cayenne
½ tsp dried oregano, ½ tsp paprika
1 cup sour cream or Greek yogurt
steps: Sauté onion in oil over medium-high 3–5 min. Add garlic 30 sec.
Add broth, green chilies, all spices, lime juice, salt and pepper.
Drain and rinse beans. Puree a ladleful with broth for creaminess. Add all beans and corn. Simmer uncovered 15–30 min.
Remove from heat. Stir in sour cream and chicken. Serve with toppings.
meals.note: 💡 For less spice: use 1 can green chilies, omit cayenne. Slow cooker: add raw chicken on low 5 hrs, shred, stir in sour cream at the end.
meals.label: Meal B

meals.name: Chicken Pineapple Fried Rice
ings: ½ lb skinless boneless chicken thighs
1½ Tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp fish sauce
Marinade: 2 tsp soy sauce, 2 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp cornstarch, ¼ tsp baking soda
steps: Break up cold day-old rice. Set aside.
Slice chicken on a bias; marinate with marinade ingredients 10–15 min.
Fry chicken in 1 Tbsp oil over medium-high until cooked through. Remove.
Sauté garlic and onions until fragrant. Add mixed vegetables and pineapple; cook 3–4 min, evaporating liquids. Push to side.
Add remaining oil and rice. Add soy sauce, fish sauce, salt and pepper. Toss everything. Add chicken back. Serve hot.
meals.note: 💡 Day-old cold rice is key — fresh rice will turn mushy.
meals.label: Meal C
